results.description:
He's a grumpy single-dad hockey coach who's sworn off love. She's the nanny who could be the only woman he ever lets into his guarded heart.

Silas Whittaker built his life around discipline, loyalty, and his sister's little girl, who now means everything to him. After too many personal losses, the last thing the Houston Wildcatters' first head coach needs is a distraction—especially one with bright red hair, teal glasses, and a smile that makes his daughter light up.

Paloma knows she shouldn't fall for her boss. She's there to help, not to get involved with a brooding, protective father whose quiet strength makes her feel safer than she has in a long time.

But long practices, late-night road trips, and a determined eight-year-old who wants to play matchmaker begin to break down all the walls Silas has put up.

The more time they spend living together, the harder it is to ignore the growing attraction between them and the scary thought that this fragile, unexpected family could last. When old wounds and fears threaten to pull them apart, Silas has to decide if he's brave enough to risk his heart again and fight for the woman who already feels like home.

Welcome to the Wildcatters Hockey Series, where wounded heroes fall hard, and love is always worth the final shot.
